messages:
maria: Kicking off a new thread: per-region "weighted degrade" rollout proposal for high-latency markets. Goal: keep <SLA tail latency while limiting user-visible regressions. Draft below.

devon: Quick ask: do we have a list of customer-critical prompts to protect? we should pin those to opt-out by default.

maria: Good point. we'll surface a small protected prompt set (prod-eval) + tenant-level opt-out.

ryan: SRE input: recommended hard thresholds to gate ramps: 95p latency > 1.3x baseline for 10m OR error-rate delta > 0.7% -> pause and rollback. Also propose concurrency cap per region.

anya: From CS: enterprise legal wants audit trail for opt-outs and a clear path for customers to request temporary exemption. SLA for rollbacks = 30m for P1 incidents.

devon: Proposed rollout stages: shadow 12-24h -> micro canary (0.5% tenants, 1h) -> small ramp (3%, 4h) -> medium (15%, 12h) -> wide (50% policy). Each stage has telemetry gates + A/B quality checks.

maria: Additions: per-tenant grace tokens (TTL) so customers who opt-out stay exempt for N days; org-scoped kill-switch that flips entire region; require two approvers to exceed 5% region weight.

ryan: Fallbacks: primary fallback = route to quantized model variant (redwood-q4f) with logging. Secondary fallback = route to hosted fallback pool with degraded throughput. Also ensure KV cache warming to avoid cold spikes.

devon: Pseudocode for flag config (keeping as string here):
```yaml
flag_name: region_weighted_degrade
scope: region,tenant
stages:
  - name: shadow
    weight: 0
    duration: 24h
  - name: micro_canary
    weight: 0.5%
    duration: 1h
    gate: latency_95 < 1.3x AND error_rate_delta < 0.7%
  - name: small_ramp
    weight: 3%
    duration: 4h
  - name: medium_ramp
    weight: 15%
    duration: 12h
  - name: policy
    weight: 50%
fallbacks:
  - try_model_variant: redwood-q4f
  - route: host-fallback-pool
kill_switch: { scope: region, manual: true, audit_log: true }
```

anya: Comms blurb draft: "We'll run a controlled experiment to verify latency improvements in select regions. Enterprise customers may request exemptions through support; they'll be notified ahead of any change that affects their traffic." Short and to the point.

maria: Love it. Add dashboard widgets: per-tenant 95/99 latencies, mismatch rate vs baseline, token-usage delta, per-stage regression flags. Hook to alerts and runbook.

ryan: Runbook sketch: 1) Alert fires -> oncall acknowledges -> check mismatch & perf dashboards. 2) If gate violated, flip kill-switch for affected region -> monitor 15m. 3) If unresolved, failover to fallback pool and notify CS. 4) Run postmortem within 72h. Include exec notification path for customer-impacting incidents.

devon: A/B quality measurement: run sampled requests through both variants in shadow, compute semantic similarity + heuristic mismatch. Gate if mismatch > 1% on critical prompts or > 3% on general workloads.

ops-bot: ops-bot: flag-service: branch region-weighted-degrade queued for deploy 04/02 05:00 UTC. CI: green. :rocket:

anya: Action items: product (maria) write final comms + protected prompt list; eng (devon) implement flag + telemetry; SRE (ryan) finalize thresholds & runbook; CS (anya) define opt-out flow & support ticket template.

maria: tagging folks @devon @ryan @anya. please drop PRs/links here by EOD Wed. I'll collate and publish rollout doc.

devon: will post PR by EOD Wed.

ryan: runbook PR tomorrow morning.

anya: opt-out support template + short customer note by EOD.

maria: thanks all. meeting after merges to confirm go/no-go. :white_check_mark:
